2609.09772.title: SymbolicLight V2: Hybrid Neuromorphic Architecture and Sparse Execution for Low-Energy Language Inference
2609.09772.paper_summary: SymbolicLight V2 combines sparse event computation with continuous-state processing in a hybrid neuromorphic language architecture. Extending V1's spike-gated dual paths, it adds graded signed events at further projections and softmax-free local attention. We implement the 194M-parameter model on an Alveo U50C FPGA using digital fixed-point arithmetic and on an ARM CPU using sparse integer execution. Across three same-checkpoint FPGA implementations at 175 MHz, active-row weight gathering and valid-state KV loading raise decode throughput from 474.6 to 643.2 tokens/s for a 32-token prefix and 128 outputs. Estimated gross card energy falls from 0.06087 to 0.04407 J per generated token, a 27.6% reduction. Complete-request energy, including prefill, falls by 24.4-27.7% across three prefix lengths. An independent idle split attributes 82.8% of gross card energy to loaded idle, explaining the benefit of shorter token latency. Against the recorded RTX 5090 compiled-FP32 baseline, integer FPGA execution uses 89.1% less estimated card energy during short-context decode; arithmetic precisions differ, and the GPU baseline is not the lowest-energy tested configuration. On four Cortex-A76 cores of a ROCK 5T, complete requests reach 65.4 tokens/s at 9.80 W and 0.151 J per generated token at the adapter's AC input. These results connect event sparsity to omitted computation and data movement. The mechanisms also support other dedicated V2 implementations: increasing throughput by a greater factor than active power lowers energy per generated token. Evaluation holds the deployed checkpoint fixed; its quality trails a same-budget dense control, so the results do not establish equal-quality efficiency.
2609.09772.paper_summary_zh: SymbolicLight V2 結合了稀疏事件計算與連續狀態處理，形成一種混合的神經形態語言架構。擴展了 V1 的脈衝閘雙通路，它在進一步的投影中增加了有序的簽名事件和無 softmax 的局部注意力。我們在 Alveo U50C FPGA 上實現了 194M 參數模型，使用數位定點算術，並在 ARM CPU 上使用稀疏整數執行。在三個相同檢查點的 FPGA 實現中，以 175 MHz 運行，活動行權重收集和有效狀態 KV 加載將解碼吞吐量從 474.6 提升至 643.2 tokens/s，對於 32-token 前綴和 128 個輸出。估計的總卡能量從每生成一個 token 的 0.06087 降至 0.04407 J，減少了 27.6%。完整請求的能量，包括預填，則在三個前綴長度之間下降了 24.4-27.7%。獨立的空閒分割將 82.8% 的總卡能量歸因於加載的空閒，解釋了較短 token 延遲的好處。與記錄的 RTX 5090 編譯的 FP32 基準相比，整數 FPGA 執行在短上下文解碼期間使用了 89.1% 更少的估計卡能量；算術精度有所不同，且 GPU 基準並不是測試過的最低能量配置。在 ROCK 5T 的四個 Cortex-A76 核心上，完整請求在適配器的 AC 輸入下達到 65.4 tokens/s，並且每生成一個 token 的能量為 9.80 W 和 0.151 J。這些結果將事件稀疏性與省略的計算和數據移動聯繫起來。這些機制還支持其他專用的 V2 實現：通過更大幅度的吞吐量提高來降低每生成一個 token 的能量。評估保持已部署的檢查點固定；其質量落後於同預算的密集控制，因此結果並未建立等質量效率。
